subject: Technology & Online Life
english: Do you use your phone a lot?

exampleSentences.portuguese: Usas muito o telemóvel durante o dia?
exampleSentences.english: Do you use your phone a lot during the day?

subject: Technology & Online Life
english: I check my email every day.
portuguese: Vejo o meu email todos os dias.
pronunciationNote: VEH-zhoo oo may-oo ee-MAIL TOH-dooz oosh DEE-ash

exampleSentences.portuguese: De manhã, vejo o meu email todos os dias.
exampleSentences.english: In the morning, I check my email every day.

subject: Technology & Online Life
notes: Useful when using a phone or laptop.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Preciso de um carregador. A minha bateria está fraca.
exampleSentences.english: I need a charger. My battery is low.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Desculpa, tens um carregador?
exampleSentences.english: Sorry, do you have a charger?

subject: Technology & Online Life
english: Can I charge my phone here?
notes: Useful in cafes and public spaces.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Posso carregar o telemóvel aqui por um bocadinho?
exampleSentences.english: Can I charge my phone here for a bit?

subject: Technology & Online Life
notes: Basic complaint about Wi-Fi or data.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Hoje a internet está lenta.
exampleSentences.english: Today the internet is slow.

subject: Technology & Online Life
notes: Useful in cafes, hotels, and public places.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Desculpe, há Wi-Fi aqui?
exampleSentences.english: Excuse me, is there Wi-Fi here?

subject: Technology & Online Life
portuguese: Qual é a palavra-passe do Wi-Fi?
pronunciationNote: kwahl eh ah pah-LAHV-rah PAH-s doo wai-fai

exampleSentences.portuguese: Qual é a palavra-passe do Wi-Fi, por favor?
exampleSentences.english: What is the Wi-Fi password, please?

exampleSentences.portuguese: Aqui o sinal está fraco.
exampleSentences.english: The signal is weak here.

subject: Technology & Online Life
english: I need to connect to the internet.
portuguese: Preciso de me ligar à internet.
pronunciationNote: preh-SEE-zoo d m lee-GAR ah een-ter-NET

exampleSentences.portuguese: Preciso de me ligar à internet para trabalhar.
exampleSentences.english: I need to connect to the internet to work.

subject: Technology & Online Life
english: Can you send me the link?

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quando puderes, podes enviar-me o link?
exampleSentences.english: When you can, can you send me the link?

exampleSentences.portuguese: Enviei-te uma mensagem há pouco.
exampleSentences.english: I sent you a message a little while ago.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Recebeste a minha mensagem de ontem?
exampleSentences.english: Did you get my message from yesterday?

exampleSentences.portuguese: Não consigo entrar. Esqueci-me da palavra-passe.
exampleSentences.english: I cannot get in. I forgot my password.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Não consigo entrar na aplicação.
exampleSentences.english: I cannot log in to the app.

subject: Technology & Online Life
portuguese: A aplicação não está a funcionar.
pronunciationNote: ah ah-plee-kah-SOWN nown esh-TAH ah foon-see-oh-NAR

exampleSentences.portuguese: Hoje a aplicação não está a funcionar bem.
exampleSentences.english: Today the app is not working well.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Não consigo usar bem o telemóvel. O meu ecrã está partido.
exampleSentences.english: I cannot use my phone properly. My screen is broken.

subject: Technology & Online Life
english: I need to update my phone.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Preciso de atualizar o telemóvel esta noite.
exampleSentences.english: I need to update my phone tonight.

subject: Technology & Online Life
english: Can we make a video call?

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se quiseres, podemos fazer uma videochamada.
exampleSentences.english: If you want, we can make a video call.

subject: Technology & Online Life
notes: Useful in phone and video calls.

exampleSentences.portuguese: A ligação está má. Não te oço bem.
exampleSentences.english: The connection is bad. I cannot hear you well.

exampleSentences.portuguese: A tua câmara está desligada no Zoom.
exampleSentences.english: Your camera is off on Zoom.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Consegues ver o meu ecrã agora?
exampleSentences.english: Can you see my screen now?

subject: Technology & Online Life
english: I am working from home today.
portuguese: Hoje estou a trabalhar a partir de casa.
pronunciationNote: OH-zh esh-TOH ah trah-bah-LYAR ah pahr-TEER d KAH-zah

exampleSentences.portuguese: Hoje estou a trabalhar a partir de casa o dia todo.
exampleSentences.english: Today I am working from home all day.

subject: Technology & Online Life
english: I am in an online meeting.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Não posso falar agora. Estou numa reunião online.
exampleSentences.english: I cannot talk now. I am in an online meeting.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Há barulho. Podes desligar o microfone?
exampleSentences.english: There is noise. Can you mute your microphone?

subject: Technology & Online Life
english: I need to download this file.
notes: European Portuguese uses ficheiro for file.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Preciso de descarregar este ficheiro para a reunião.
exampleSentences.english: I need to download this file for the meeting.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Podes abrir o ficheiro que te mandei?
exampleSentences.english: Can you open the file I sent you?

subject: Technology & Online Life
english: It takes a long time to load.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Hoje a página demora muito tempo a carregar.
exampleSentences.english: Today the page takes a long time to load.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Não consigo entrar porque o site está em baixo.
exampleSentences.english: I cannot access it because the website is down.

subject: Technology & Online Life
english: I only saw your message now.
portuguese: Só vi a tua mensagem agora.
pronunciationNote: soh vee ah TOO-ah men-SAH-zheng ah-GOH-rah

exampleSentences.portuguese: Desculpa, só vi a tua mensagem agora.
exampleSentences.english: Sorry, I only saw your message now.

subject: Technology & Online Life
notes: Useful in chat or work contexts.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se eu não responder, estou offline neste momento.
exampleSentences.english: If I do not reply, I am offline right now.

subject: Technology & Online Life
portuguese: Preciso de mais espaço de armazenamento.
pronunciationNote: preh-SEE-zoo d mysh esh-PAH-soo d ar-mah-zeh-nah-MEN-too

exampleSentences.portuguese: Não consigo guardar mais fotos. Preciso de mais espaço de armazenamento.
exampleSentences.english: I cannot save more photos. I need more storage space.

subject: Technology & Online Life
english: I need to save this document.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Antes de fechar, preciso de guardar este documento.
exampleSentences.english: Before closing, I need to save this document.

subject: Technology & Online Life
english: Can you send it as a PDF?

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se for possível, podes enviar isso em PDF?
exampleSentences.english: If possible, can you send it as a PDF?

subject: Technology & Online Life
english: I forgot to attach the file.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Peço desculpa, esqueci-me de anexar o ficheiro.
exampleSentences.english: Sorry, I forgot to attach the file.

subject: Technology & Online Life
portuguese: Vê a pasta de spam, por favor.
pronunciationNote: veh ah PAHSH-tah d spam poor fah-VOR

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se não recebeste nada, vê a pasta de spam, por favor.
exampleSentences.english: If you did not receive anything, please check your spam folder.

subject: Technology & Online Life
english: I need help with this website.
portuguese: Preciso de ajuda com este site.
pronunciationNote: preh-SEE-zoo d ah-ZHOO-dah kong ESH-t site

exampleSentences.portuguese: Não percebo bem isto. Preciso de ajuda com este site.
exampleSentences.english: I do not really understand this. I need help with this website.

subject: Technology & Online Life
english: Can you show me how to do it?

exampleSentences.portuguese: Não sei usar isto. Podes mostrar-me como se faz?
exampleSentences.english: I do not know how to use this. Can you show me how to do it?

subject: Technology & Online Life
english: I do not use that app.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Não uso essa aplicação, mas posso instalar.
exampleSentences.english: I do not use that app, but I can install it.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quando vou a pé para o trabalho, costumo ouvir podcasts.
exampleSentences.english: When I walk to work, I usually listen to podcasts.

exampleSentences.portuguese: À noite, vejo vídeos online.
exampleSentences.english: At night, I watch videos online.

subject: Technology & Online Life
english: Do you follow them on social media?

exampleSentences.portuguese: Segues-os nas redes sociais ou não?
exampleSentences.english: Do you follow them on social media or not?

subject: Technology & Online Life
english: I do not post much online.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Vejo muita coisa, mas não publico muito online.
exampleSentences.english: I watch a lot of things, but I do not post much online.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Para eu ver melhor, podes partilhar o ecrã?
exampleSentences.english: So I can see better, can you share your screen?

subject: Technology & Online Life
english: I need to restart the computer.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Está muito lento. Preciso de reiniciar o computador.
exampleSentences.english: It is very slow. I need to restart the computer.

subject: Technology & Online Life
english: It works better on my laptop.

exampleSentences.portuguese: No telemóvel é estranho, mas funciona melhor no meu portátil.
exampleSentences.english: It is strange on my phone, but it works better on my laptop.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Preciso de imprimir isto hoje.
exampleSentences.english: I need to print this today.

subject: Technology & Online Life
english: Can you email it to me?

exampleSentences.portuguese: Em vez de mensagem, podes mandar-me isso por email?
exampleSentences.english: Instead of a message, can you email it to me?

subject: Technology & Online Life
english: I am waiting for a reply.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Ainda estou à espera de resposta deles.
exampleSentences.english: I am still waiting for their reply.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Agora não consigo, mas envio isso mais tarde.
exampleSentences.english: I cannot do it now, but I will send it later.
